name: PinOps
description_en:
PinOps at pinops.app is a hosted Pinterest creation and publishing workspace for people promoting articles, affiliate guides, products or services they already own. AI Designer prepares editable copy and layouts from a public source URL; Design Studio edits layers and reusable layouts, while CSV Import handles structured campaigns. Queue/My Pins and Scheduler represent the same publishing jobs.

The operational decision is how a page becomes a reviewed Pin with the correct image, destination, board and time. Creation is separate from approval, scheduled delivery and audience results. PinOps is narrower than a multi-network inbox or general social suite, and AI Designer is not a synthetic-image generator. It fits publishers with real destination pages and usable assets; it is a weaker fit for someone seeking guaranteed traffic or sales. This research reviewed documentation and pricing without creating an account, generating content or publishing.
description_zh:
pinops.app 的 PinOps 是托管 Pinterest 创作及发布工作区，面向推广自有文章、联盟指南、商品或服务的人。AI Designer 按公开来源 URL 准备可编辑文案及布局，Design Studio 编辑图层与可复用布局，CSV Import 处理结构化活动。Queue／My Pins 与 Scheduler 表示同一批发布任务。

操作核心是让页面变为已审 Pin，具有准确图片、目的地、board 及时间。创作与批准、定时投递、受众效果各自独立。PinOps 比多网络收件箱或综合社交套件更聚焦，AI Designer 也不是合成图像生成器。它适合有真实目的地及可用素材的发布者，不适合追求保证流量或销售者。本研究阅读文档及定价，未注册、生成内容或发布。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: USD monthly: Pro $19, Agency $69, Enterprise $149. Eligible new monthly subscribers get the first cycle at $0, then automatic regular-price renewal; annual plans excluded. Free is ongoing/no-card: 50 scheduled Pins, 20 AI credits, one account and three CSV imports/month, 100 MB media. Pro: 2,000 Pins/1,000 credits/5 accounts; Agency 15,000/10,000/25; Enterprise unlimited Pins/accounts but 30,000 credits. Storage is 5/25/100 GB. Annual amounts, tax-inclusive checkout and quota reset/carryover rules unverified. No normalized price assigned.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: USD 月付 Pro $19、Agency $69、Enterprise $149。合格新月付订户首周期 $0，之后自动常规价续费，不含年付。Free 持续免卡：月 50 计划 Pin、20 AI 点、一个账户、三次 CSV、100 MB 媒体。Pro 为 2,000 Pin／1,000 点／5 账户，Agency 15,000／10,000／25，Enterprise Pin／账户不限但仅 30,000 点。存储分别 5／25／100 GB。年付金额、含税结算及额度重置／结转规则未核，不分配标准化价格。

official_check.scope: Official public documentation only; no purchase, account operation, sending test, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_en: AI Designer uses your source images and requires editorial review
sections.title_zh: AI Designer 使用来源图片，需编辑审阅
sections.en: The documented flow analyzes an article/product URL, offers titles, descriptions, keywords and CTAs, chooses a template or Studio, then moves the finished concept toward Queue. Discovered images are originals from the supplied URL; users choose one or replace it with an upload. This workflow does not generate synthetic images. Editorial affiliate-guide example: confirm the actual product claim, image rights and destination before accepting a suggested headline. A source page that refuses automated reading may still be valid; use content/assets you are authorized to supply rather than assuming a failed fetch means the product page disappeared.
sections.zh: 文档流程分析文章／商品 URL，给出标题、说明、关键词、CTA，选择模板或 Studio，再让完成概念进入 Queue 流程。发现图片为所提供 URL 原图，用户选择或上传替换，该流程不生成合成图片。编辑联盟指南示例：接受建议标题前确认真实商品主张、图片权利及目的地。拒绝自动读取的来源页仍可能有效，应使用有权提供的内容／素材，不能把抓取失败理解为商品页消失。

sections.title_en: Save Template creates reusable work; Export PNG does not publish
sections.title_zh: Save Template 建立可复用成果，Export PNG 不发布
sections.en: Design Studio edits text/image layers, layout and brand styling; the current page uses Design Studio while older navigation labels say Canva Studio. That label alone does not establish a Canva integration. Save Template stores a layout for later Studio Template Import; Export PNG only downloads the current image. Brand Kit settings are separate per connected Pinterest profile, including site, logo, colors and fonts. Editorial multi-brand preparation: select the intended profile, save its brand, inspect text/logo fit and approve the complete Pin with caption, link and board rather than only its image.
sections.zh: Design Studio 编辑文字／图片图层、布局及品牌样式，现行页称 Design Studio，旧导航称 Canva Studio，单凭标签不能确定 Canva 集成。Save Template 存布局用于后续 Studio Template Import，Export PNG 仅下载当前图片。Brand Kit 按连接的 Pinterest 账户分别保存网站、标志、颜色、字体。编辑多品牌准备：选准确账户、存品牌，检查文字／标志是否适配，并批准含说明、链接、board 的完整 Pin，不能只审图片。

sections.title_en: Import mode and row overrides determine the campaign
sections.title_zh: 导入模式及逐行覆盖决定活动
sections.en: Smart CSV requires title, description, image_path and link, one row per Pin, title up to 100 characters and public image URLs. An explicit row template overrides the import-wide choice; blank template uses automatic design assignment. Studio Template Import first selects a saved layout and its own sample, whose fields depend on that design. Blank board enables matching; an explicit board should use the exact synced name. Uploading prepares previews, not publication. Check highlighted problems, approve the selected items and inspect the number actually added to Queue. Editorial bulk handoff: correct only unresolved Pins instead of assuming the entire file failed.
sections.zh: Smart CSV 必填 title、description、image_path、link，每行一 Pin，标题最多 100 字符，图片 URL 需公开。行内明确 template 覆盖全局选择，空值用自动分配。Studio Template Import 先选已存布局及专用样例，其字段取决于设计。board 空值启用匹配，明确值应为已同步准确名称。上传准备预览，不发布。检查高亮问题、批准所选项，再核实际入队数。编辑批量交接：只修未解决 Pin，不能假设整文件全败。

sections.title_en: A suggested board remains a destination to confirm
sections.title_zh: 建议 board 仍需确认目的地
sections.en: Boards sync from the connected profile. Review the selected account when several connections exist, and sync again after a board is created or renamed on Pinterest. Queue documentation asks users to confirm a suggested board, creative, title/description, destination URL, disclosure where needed and timing. A missing board should prompt profile/sync and Activity checks before creating a second copy. Editorial campaign acceptance: inspect the board on the actual intended profile and preserve the original destination link; an apparently relevant board name does not verify brand ownership or that publishing permission remains valid.
sections.zh: Boards 从连接账户同步。多个连接时检查所选账户，Pinterest 新建／改名后重新同步。Queue 文档要求确认建议 board、创意、标题／说明、目的地、需要的披露及时间。缺失 board 应先查账户／同步及 Activity，再创建第二份。编辑活动验收：在准确账户查看真实 board 并保留原目的地链接，相关名称不能验证品牌归属或发布权限仍有效。

sections.title_en: The workspace timezone controls the existing job
sections.title_zh: 工作区时区控制现有任务
sections.en: Scheduler and My Pins show the same jobs. Editing a future date/time completes a publishing confirmation and updates the existing job, not another Pin; the workspace timezone applies rather than the editing laptop. CSV explicit scheduling needs both future date and time, while both blank fields use automatic assignment. Posting windows can spread automatic items into later days, and publishing protection can delay closely spaced supplied times. Editorial timed promotion: inspect the assigned job, timezone and final status after approval. A future scheduled item should wait; an already assigned date is not proof it has published.
sections.zh: Scheduler 与 My Pins 显示同一任务。修改未来日期／时间经发布确认后更新现有任务，不另建 Pin；使用工作区时区而非编辑电脑。CSV 明确排程需未来日期、时间两栏，均为空则自动分配。发布窗口可能将自动项分散到后续日期，发布保护也可能延迟间隔过密的指定时间。编辑定时推广：批准后检查分配任务、时区及最终状态。未来计划项应等待，已有日期不证明已发布。

sections.title_en: Repair the existing failed job before making another
sections.title_zh: 另建之前修复现有失败任务
sections.en: Troubleshooting distinguishes expired connection, unavailable board, inaccessible media and destination problems. Inspect Failed in My Pins and the related Activity result, correct the cause and retry the existing Pin. If delivery is unclear, check the Pinterest profile first to avoid duplicating a successful publication. Activity separates successful, warning and error outcomes; it is evidence to investigate, not authorization to repeat everything. Editorial incident record: retain the title, exact error and time, then verify the corrected job’s current state. The documents do not establish an automatic retry count, idempotency guarantee or delivery SLA.
sections.zh: 故障文档区分连接到期、board 不可用、媒体无法访问、目的地问题。检查 My Pins 的 Failed 及关联 Activity，修因后重试现有 Pin。投递不明先查 Pinterest 账户，避免复制已成功发布。Activity 区分成功、警告、错误，是调查证据，不是重做全部动作的授权。编辑故障记录：保留标题、准确错误及时间，再核修正任务当前状态。文档未确定自动重试次数、幂等保证或投递 SLA。

sections.title_en: Profile results, publishing health and ideas answer different questions
sections.title_zh: 账户效果、发布健康及创意回答不同问题
sections.en: Profile Analytics uses the connected profile’s available metrics and reporting period. Missing data is not zero, and a newly published Pin may need time before metrics appear. Publishing Overview instead counts PinOps jobs and their states. Pinterest Trends requires reading region, source and period; AI Content Planner prepares ideas from inputs separately from live trend data. Editorial report: compare the same profile/dates, inspect failed jobs separately and do not present generated ideas as measured search volume. Impressions, saves and outbound clicks remain different outcomes; none alone demonstrates incremental purchases.
sections.zh: Profile Analytics 使用连接账户可得指标及报告期，缺失不等于零，新发 Pin 可能需等待数据。Publishing Overview 则统计 PinOps 任务及状态。Pinterest Trends 需读地区、来源、周期，AI Content Planner 根据输入准备创意，与实时趋势独立。编辑报告：统一账户／日期，另查失败任务，不把生成创意当实测搜索量。展示、保存、出站点击是不同结果，任何单项都不证明增量购买。

sections.title_en: Generation credits do not equal publishing allowance
sections.title_zh: 生成点数不等于发布额度
sections.en: Pricing specifies two AI credits per generated Pin and another two for regeneration; five copy variations cost ten. Board suggestions cost one per analyzed post, while matching existing boards and creating boards are free; editor AI optimization costs one per Pin. These actions share finite generation capacity independently of scheduled-Pin limits. Editorial budget: count drafting, revision and board analysis separately before a batch. Check Usage & storage for the actual current period and capacity rather than treating included credits as successful publications.
sections.zh: 定价规定每生成 Pin 两 AI 点，重生成再两点，五份文案变体十点。Board 建议每分析帖一点，匹配已有 board 及创建免费，编辑器 AI 优化每 Pin 一点。这些动作使用有限生成容量，独立于计划 Pin 上限。编辑预算：批次前分别计算草稿、修订、board 分析。应查 Usage & storage 的真实周期及容量，不能把含点数当成功发布数。

sections.title_en: An invoice and a refund request have different meanings
sections.title_zh: 账单与退款申请含义不同
sections.en: Dodo Payments is the documented merchant of record. Billing shows subscription/renewal; the invoice establishes the actual charge, which can differ through offers/tax. If a successful payment has not updated access, the guide says refresh once and contact support with the invoice rather than paying again. Cancellation stops the next renewal and normally retains access through the paid period; it does not automatically refund unused time. Refunds are reviewed, with requests preferably within 14 days, not a guaranteed 14-day money-back offer. Editorial purchase check: preserve the order, renewal date and receipt before treating the welcome cycle as permanent free access.
sections.zh: 文档商户记录方为 Dodo Payments。Billing 显示订阅／续费，真实扣款由账单确定，可因优惠／税不同。成功付款未更新访问时，指南说刷新一次后携账单联系支持，不能再次付款。取消阻止下一续费，通常可用至已付周期，不自动退未用时间。退款经审查，建议 14 天内申请，并非保证 14 天退款。编辑购买检查：保留订单、续费日、回执，不能把欢迎周期当永久免费。

seo.title_en: PinOps: URL-to-Pin workflow, CSV controls and real usage costs
seo.title_zh: PinOps：URL 转 Pin、CSV 控制及真实用量费用
seo.description_en: Examine PinOps source images, Studio templates, CSV approval, timezone scheduling, failed-job recovery and separate AI/publishing limits.
seo.description_zh: 核对 PinOps 来源图片、Studio 模板、CSV 批准、时区排程、失败任务恢复及独立 AI／发布额度。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate PinOps Pinterest content creation and publishing operations
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no search volume, ranking or AI visibility measured.

research_gaps.en: Exact supported Pinterest account types/API scopes, granular team approval roles, automated retry/idempotency and delivery guarantees remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 准确 Pinterest 账户类型／API 权限、精细团队审批角色、自动重试／幂等及投递保证未核。

research_gaps.en: Annual prices, welcome eligibility details, tax-inclusive checkout, quota reset timezone/carryover and precise credit-failure charging require confirmation.
research_gaps.zh: 年付价、欢迎资格详情、含税结算、额度重置时区／结转及失败扣点需确认。

research_gaps.en: Analytics history, refresh latency/export coverage, source licence, self-hosting, regional access and UI-language support remain unknown.
research_gaps.zh: 分析历史、刷新延迟／导出覆盖、源码许可、自托管、地区访问及界面语言未知。

research_gaps.en: No account, Pinterest authorization, generation, CSV import, board creation, billing or publishing action was executed; traffic/sales/time-saving claims not measured.
research_gaps.zh: 未执行账户、Pinterest 授权、生成、CSV 导入、board 创建、计费或发布，未测流量／销售／节时主张。
